en: Vintage sepia-toned postcard with an illustration of the Parthenon temple on the Acropolis at the top left, depicted in a classical drawing style. Below it, there is a rectangular inset showing a profile of an ancient Greek-style marble bust. The rest of the card is mostly blank for writing. Small Greek text appears in the bottom left and right corners, and a website watermark 'www.elia.org.gr' is overprinted across the lower section.
